title: Restore owner literals the CEO paraphrases out of delegated workstream goals
description: BASE 44e4bc5, R3 (audit R2 corrections) — extractor-only fixes in src/pair/objective-source-terms.ts. R3-F1: stripLiteralTail no longer strips '='/'+' at a literal tail — those are legal URL data (base64 signature tails, empty-valued query params); prose punctuation can never attach to a URL without whitespace, which already ends the match. R2 tail cases (parens/brackets/prose wrappers) preserved. R3-F2: the quoted keep-pattern is bounded at {1,160}, so an oversized quoted literal could never match and was silently ignored; a dedicated OVERSIZED_QUOTED_LITERAL pre-scan under identical boundary rules now throws FAIL_CLOSED_OBJECTIVE_WORKSTREAM_LITERALS for ANY quoted run >160 chars, inside the atomic commit txn (zero residue proven). Unchanged: broadcast preservation, raw-proposal normalized digest, enriched WDEC digest, replay/amend, atomic commit, goal cap 2048, 24-literal/160-char bounds, DC→DL→operator_goal propagation. Files: objective-source-terms.ts, patch-claim.json, test file (29 tests). Executed: 4/4 new regressions failed on R2 HEAD a1050c0 then pass post-fix; focused 29/29; P15.2 31/31 + P15.4 37/37; tsc clean. PLAN_DATAFLOW_UNBOUND out of scope. No merge claimed.
